articles.title: A crypto pioneer who turned a $20 million family stake into a billion-dollar fund doubles down on bitcoin
articles.snippet: Sourcing initial capital from his mother to build a $1 billion crypto empire, DFG CEO James Wo says market metrics do not support Tom Lee’s $250,000 ether prediction.

articles.title: Coinbase to launch token-backed mortgage down payments this summer
articles.snippet: A Coinbase-Better Home & Finance initiative will allow qualified borrowers to use Bitcoin and USDC as collateral for home loan down payments.

articles.title: Claude Code Vulnerability Could Let Attackers Steal Credentials From GitHub, Says Microsoft
articles.snippet: Researchers say prompt injection attacks could manipulate AI coding agents to access sensitive credentials stored in software development pipelines.

articles.title: As BTC Tests $62,000, How Low Can Bitcoin Go?
articles.snippet: Bitcoin has dropped 17% in four days, sparking $4.5 billion in liquidations, as analysts warn of a potential move below $60,000.
